purpose: Durable per-workspace shared-safety capacity authority. One complete workspace_capacity row carries the current defaults revision/digest, monotonic authority revision and regional capacity fence; immutable capacity_audit rows retain every committed decision identity. The controller atomically writes this authority together with the complete public effective-limit projection.

serverSideEncryption.rationale: Capacity decisions are a regional authority with a distinct write role and recovery boundary; they must not share the session or authorization-projection key authority.

stream.rationale: Capacity commands are explicit direct invokes and publish their serving projection in the same transaction; there is no asynchronous second writer to catch up.

timeToLive.rationale: An expired authority or audit row would either fail every request or erase the evidence for an override, so neither family is TTL data.
